race.comment: JUST FLYING (2) has made a late charge but just been denied at his last two runs, most recently over this course and distance in a BM85. This looks a shade easier so a well-earned win might be ready to come his way. Genuine mare COOL MUSIC (11) began awkwardly but rallied late to be beaten just over two lengths over 1400m at Eagle Farm last Saturday. Narrowly defeated here at the mile two back. Great lightweight hope on the seven-day turnaround. NORTH POLE (1) ran on well without threatening in the same race as JUST FLYING here a fortnight back. Likes Doomben and from a decent draw looks sure to be about the mark. PURE ALPHA (6) did nothing first-up but is the winner of two from four second-up so expect a bit more this time.
